# docker_compose_port (Data Source)

Finds the public port of a service's port binding, like `docker compose port <service> <port>`, from the container's `NetworkSettings.Ports`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_port" "web" {
  name         = "shop"
  service      = "web"
  private_port = 80
}

output "web_url" {
  value = "http://localhost:${data.docker_compose_port.web.published_port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).
- `private_port` (Number) The container port.
- `service` (String) The service name.

### Optional

- `index` (Number) The container number when the service has several (CLI `--index`). Default `1`.
- `protocol` (String) The port protocol: `tcp` (default), `udp` or `sctp`.

### Read-Only

- `bindings` (Attributes List) Every host binding of the requested service port (NetworkSettings.Ports["<port>/<proto>"]). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bindings))
- `container_id` (String) The container that was inspected.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `host_ip` (String) The host IP of the first binding (empty: all interfaces).
- `published_port` (Number) The host port of the first binding; null when the port is not published.

<a id="nestedatt--bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bindings`

Read-Only:

- `host_ip` (String) Upstream `HostIp`.
- `host_port` (String) Upstream `HostPort`.
